title.narrative: Provision of life-saving nutrition-sensitive assistance to crisis affected population in Local Government Areas in NE Nigeria

description.narrative: WFP will deploy a food and nutrition assistance package supporting 159,199 extremely food insecure people, including nutritionally vulnerable members of their households, 9,838 Pregnant and Breastfeeding Women and Girls (PBWGs) and 14,883 children under 2 years of age. Each beneficiary targeted will receive a voucher that serves the purpose of meeting basic food needs, especially during lean season when most of them do not have enough food intake. Within those households, PBWGs and children under 2 years of age will receive an additional nutrition top in the form of monthly voucher which provides access to animal source foods, fruits and vegetables. This nutrition sensitive approach ensures that women and children in the first 1,000 days of life have access to nutrient dense foods to prevent new cases of child wasting and maternal undernutrition from occurring in situations of increased risks and high vulnerability
